name: Holochain Launcher
description: electron-updater; hApp bundles from an appstore/devhub over the DHT are a separate content channel.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater classification: Launcher disables auto-download, checks packaged updates at launch with a semver compatibility gate, and separately downloads then quits-and-installs only after the install mutation is invoked.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in configuration.
Where electron-updater/Squirrel/install4j performs final verification, the external framework implementation is not vendored here.
